hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Warn about console.log left in JS files
FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"
[[ "$FILE" != *.js ]] && exit 0
MATCHES=$(grep -n 'console\.log' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
[ -z "$MATCHES" ] && exit 0
echo "[Hook] console.log found in $FILE — remove before shipping:" >&2
echo "$MATCHES" >&2
exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# Detect hardcoded secrets in JS/HTML files
FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"
[[ "$FILE" != *.js && "$FILE" != *.html ]] && exit 0
PATTERNS='(SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY|service_role|sk-ant-|ghp_|AKIA[A-Z0-9])'
MATCHES=$(grep -nE "$PATTERNS" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
[ -z "$MATCHES" ] && exit 0
echo "[Hook][SECURITY] Possible hardcoded secret in $FILE:" >&2
echo "$MATCHES" >&2
exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# Warn about destructive SQL in migration files
FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"
[[ "$FILE" != *.sql ]] && exit 0
MATCHES=$(grep -inE '(DROP TABLE|TRUNCATE|DELETE FROM [a-z])' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
[ -z "$MATCHES" ] && exit 0
echo "[Hook][WARN] Destructive SQL in migration $FILE — double-check intent:" >&2
echo "$MATCHES" >&2
exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# Remind to create PR after push
CMD="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND:-}"
[[ "$CMD" != *"git push"* ]] && exit 0
echo "[Hook] After pushing, remember: create/update the draft PR on the claude/new-session-A4YNx branch." >&2
exit 0
